name: Disa the Restless
description: An explorer who returned from a disastrous voyage west and helped fight the undead.

description_citations.text: "Klazina Jansdotter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disa the Restless's expedition travels far west and finds ice walls blocking travel.
timeline.quote: "We are farther west than any could have imagined possible, but I still wish to press on.

citation.text: Glacial Wall (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Disa the Restless records the pass blocked by an avalanche, forcing the expedition back.
timeline.quote: "The pass was completely blocked by the avalanche; we're forced to turn back.

citation.text: Avalanche (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Disa records the Dryads' lies led to deaths in the cold.
timeline.quote: The rest believed their lies, and their skeletons weren't found until the thaw."

citation.text: Rime Dryad (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Disa records the Shaman waving a staff and the land going mad.
timeline.quote: "The Shaman waved the staff, and the land itself went mad."

citation.text: Anarchy (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ten years after Lim-Dûl's first attacks, Disa leads an expedition west seeking allies against the necromancer, reaching a huge wall of ice and finding no one to help Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: Disa led an expedition into the west in the hope of finding allies to fight together against the necromancer.

citation.text: "Disa", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disa, Lucilde and Klazina take refuge from a storm at the village of Mikkel and find the church occupied by Halvor and Kaysa.
timeline.quote: the three reached the village church, where the priest Halvor Arenson and his protegee Kaysa were the only attendants

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The undead villagers break into the church; Kolbjörn and Kaysa chant the song of Freyalise, stripping the undead of life.
timeline.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa goes with Kolbjörn to Fyndhorn with Halvor's consent, and Disa travels with them.
timeline.quote: Disa would travel with Kolbjörn and Kaysa to Fyndhorn.

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disa defeats and tames a lhurgoyf that ambushed her party, learning to tame others as guides.
timeline.quote: Disa faced it head-on and, after a grueling fight, managed to defeat and subdue it

citation.text: "Disa", section "Encountering lhurgoyfs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disa dies in the plagues that ravaged Terisiare during the Flood Age.
timeline.quote: Disa was one of the victims of the plagues that ravaged Terisiare during the Flood Age

citation.text: "Disa", section "Fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klazina, Lucilde and Disa are caught in a storm and take refuge in Mikkel's church with Halvor and Kaysa.
timeline.quote: the three women were caught by a storm and forced to seek refuge in the village of Mikkel

citation.text: "Klazina Jansdotter", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The knights fight the undead villagers; Kolbjörn and Kaysa's song of Freyalise destroys them.
timeline.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

citation.text: "Klazina Jansdotter", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn mourns Disa and vows to stop the pestilence.
timeline.quote: "Disa is dead, and I am left. I shall allow no others to succumb to this pestilence."

citation.text: Stench of Decay (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Disa admits doubts about the mistfolk due to eyewitness accounts.
timeline.quote: my certainty is lessened by the cursed consistency of the expedition's eyewitness accounts.

citation.text: Mistfolk (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
